same-origin redirect behaviour, 404 mapping, URLError and timeout behaviour, and the read_json_artifact redirect model are preserved

ruff and mypy clean on changed files
expected_outputs: dedicated atlas/agent-* branch with exact HEAD/TREE
statement:
HARDEN-DEVLOOP-001: GitHubRestPort authenticated generic API requests must never forward the Authorization header through a redirect to another origin.
Defect, observed offline on the sealed base: in src/project_atlas/orchestration/autonomy/dev_github_port.py, GitHubRestPort._request sends 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' through urllib.request.urlopen. urllib's default redirect handler follows 3xx responses and copies the Authorization header to the Location target. A 302 from the API to a different origin delivers the token to that origin.
Required behaviour of _request after your change. The token is only ever sent to the API origin (the scheme, host and port of the module constant API). A 301, 302, 303, 307 or 308 response whose Location resolves to a different origin raises AdapterError and the Authorization header is never sent to that origin. Same-origin redirect behaviour is preserved: a redirect to the API origin keeps working as on the base. A 404 still returns (404, None). Other HTTP errors, URLError and timeouts still raise AdapterError exactly as on the base. Error messages and exceptions name only the HTTP method and request path; they never contain token bytes, the Location URL or any Location query data. read_json_artifact keeps its existing explicit artifact-download redirect model unchanged: no automatic redirects, a validated https Location, and the blob fetched without Authorization.
Add the new tests in a new file tests/unit/test_orchestration_dev_github_port_redirects.py. They must run offline only, using in-process local HTTP servers or a stubbed opener, with no network access. Cover each redirect status to a different origin: AdapterError is raised and that origin never receives Authorization. Cover a same-origin redirect, 404, URLError, timeout, error-message redaction of token and Location query, and that the artifact download path still works. The new cross-origin tests must fail on the sealed base revision and pass on your result. Keep the existing tests in tests/unit/test_orchestration_dev_github_port.py passing; you may extend that file if needed.
